def: (only adverb) in the language of Ashdod

occurrences.text: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
